css.method: Actual local run of Wikimedia CSS parser, StylePropertySanitizer and selector grammar with the TemplateStyles rule construction used by this stylesheet. No site-specific Wikimedia hooks are loaded. Existing dependencies were read locally, fetch was blocked, no wiki was opened.

limitations: Synthetic browser data and local illustrations only.
Native Firefox and Safari were not rerun.
The local fixture simulates two server-rendered dates; it does not execute MediaWiki parser code.
Public anonymous read-only source and existing-page HTML checks were used separately to verify ptwiki template structure. No custom profile text was sent to a remote parser.
The native calendar uses ptwiki daily selection, which can differ from Commons Wikifeeds. UTC parser date and cache determine its refresh; already-open visitor tabs do not rotate automatically.
Initial manual update of shared code/styles and regenerated profile markup is required when eventually installed. No new shared template or Lua module is required.
No Wikimedia installation, authenticated session, edit, purge, upload, clipboard write or GitHub push occurred.
